summary.text: Rafael Irizarry is the Republican candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 121 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Joe Gresko.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as political consultant.

paragraphs.text: Rafael Irizarry was born in Ponce, Puerto Rico, and earned a bachelor's degree from The World University in 1983.
According to Ballotpedia, he has been affiliated with Handicapped Children of Puerto Rico and the YMCA.
He also ran for the U.S. House in Connecticut's 3rd Congressional District in 2026 but did not appear on the August 11 Republican primary ballot.
